args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in production following its deployment. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and verified: all regions running v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate 0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after v2.3.1 health check failures

trace.final:
All done:

1. **Identified the regression**: v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and was unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rolled out successfully.
3. **Verified recovery**: service is healthy on v2.3.0 with a 0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the health check failures and the rollback; on-call has been paged.
